_status: UNVERIFIED — markers are informed guesses, not device-confirmed. Run the calibration flow with DS_DEBUG logging on and fit these to a real event dump before trusting any number from this app.
_note: Instagram calls Reels 'clips' throughout its own code, so that substring is the strongest surface marker.
YouTube's own identifiers call Shorts 'reel'. Shorts rides a ViewPager2 inside WatchWhileActivity, which is also the regular video player, so the id markers matter more than the class here.

_status: UNVERIFIED — highest-risk profile. TikTok varies most by region and build, and is heavily custom-drawn with obfuscated class names.
_note: TikTok's internal name for a post is 'aweme'. Because class names are obfuscated per build, this profile leans on the action column instead.

Facebook Reels sits inside the main activity alongside the ordinary News Feed, which also scrolls vertically full-screen. requireActionColumn is on because without it the News Feed itself would be counted as reels.
Snapchat exposes very little to accessibility and draws most of its UI itself, so expect this profile to under-count. Under-counting is the correct failure here.
